scope: Five preselected case studies, two unresolved audit gates each

alternativeExplanations: Pre-existing US-Japan and US-ROK defense alliances
Japan-ROK GSOMIA restoration and independent reconciliation
requiredDiscriminatingEvidence: Dated trilateral negotiation records showing unique US intervention
Independent Japan/ROK operational data showing new exchange performance

requiredMeasurements: Incremental integration and maintenance spending by all three governments

rows.title: 2023 Beijing agreement to resume Saudi-Iran diplomatic relations

alternativeExplanations: Saudi and Iranian bilateral security/economic interests
Regional de-escalation incentives independent of Beijing
requiredDiscriminatingEvidence: Negotiating records distinguishing Beijing's incremental role from prior talks
Independent counterpart accounts of concessions caused by Chinese intervention
Durability and security outcomes relative to earlier mediation

requiredMeasurements: Documented Chinese mediation resources and guarantees

rows.title: Russia-Belarus Union State security guarantees treaty

alternativeExplanations: Pre-existing Union State and CSTO obligations
requiredDiscriminatingEvidence: Treaty article-by-article incremental obligations versus earlier agreements
Belarusian ratification debate and independently verified implementation

requiredMeasurements: Financing and military commitments by each state

alternativeExplanations: Russia's invasion of Ukraine and Moldovan threat perceptions
requiredDiscriminatingEvidence: Specific implemented partnership deliverables distinct from EUPM baseline
Moldovan agency reporting and independent outcome audits
Evidence separating EU inducements from Moldova's autonomous preferences

requiredMeasurements: EU commitments versus appropriations versus actual disbursements
Mission operating costs and documented outcomes

rows.title: India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement enters into force

alternativeExplanations: Oil price and energy import movements
Post-pandemic trade rebound and exchange-rate shifts
UAE demand and non-CEPA policy changes
requiredDiscriminatingEvidence: Product-level tariff-line counterfactual with untreated comparator markets
Volume versus price decomposition by product
UAE and India customs data matched by fiscal period and valuation

requiredMeasurements: Tariff revenue forgone by partner and year
Distributional gains and losses and compliance costs

rule: A research plan is not a verified outcome. Do not mark gates complete until sources, measurement definitions, counterpart behavior, counterfactual and cost evidence are independently audited.
